title: Cosets and Lagrange's theorem
summary: Left and right cosets and the partition they induce; the index of a subgroup; Lagrange's theorem and its corollaries (orders of elements divide the group order, groups of prime order are cyclic, multiplicativity of the index); the converse fails (A_4 has no subgroup of order 6); Fermat's little theorem and Euler's theorem.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is chapter 6 of Judson (Sections 6.1–6.3).

preparation.description: Read Sections 6.1 and 6.3 from the chapter page: cosets and the partition of G; Fermat's and Euler's theorems.
Read Section 6.2: Proposition 6.2.1, Lagrange's theorem (Theorem 6.2.2), Corollaries 6.2.3–6.2.5, Proposition 6.2.7 (A_4 has no subgroup of order 6), Theorem 6.2.8.
Optional supplement: MIT student notes, lecture 4 (Isomorphisms and Cosets).
